DESIGN INSIGHT captured (feeds Slice 2's composition function + this subsystem's SHOULD): domains split into PROCESS-GOVERNING (inherited by every vsdd adopter to FUNCTION — the process dispatches AI [AIE], enforces via CI/hooks [PE], is circumventable + oracle-trust-dependent [RT/Security], runs on mdatron schema-data [DE], produces governed prose [DR/TW], on the SO/SA/SE/QE baseline) vs PRODUCT-REVIEWING (per the adopter's product axes: UX/A11y/Privacy/L10n + product activation of RT/DR/AIE). The composition SHOULD = process-governing-baseline UNION axis-activated-product-domains — which is what the conformance verifier then audits was loaded.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OWN-YOUR-OWN-DOCS BOUNDARY (operator ruling 2026-07-31). mdatron owns its own docs; by the same sibling-self-hosted-tool principle, crosslink owns its own docs. Correction to REQ-20 (reverses my earlier 'add mdatron.docs.search' recommendation): vsdd mcp-serve owns methodology.lookup (vsdd's own docs); mdatron + crosslink each own a queryable docs surface vsdd CONSUMES, not re-serves. Verified: crosslink has NO docs command/MCP today (only --help + knowledge pages), so vsdd scraping crosslink docs is a stopgap; correct mechanism = crosslink exposes a queryable docs surface (named upstream capability request, same pattern as the injection point / kickoff #837), consumed by vsdd. claude_code/anthropic docs = external web references (different category), pending the mcp-serve design. IMPORTANT: the mcp-serve DESIGN currently lives ONLY in the sunsetting DESIGN docs (DESIGN-OBSERVABILITY/METHODOLOGY/etc.) — the sunset coverage-check MUST preserve/re-home it into the contract or a slice design (it is a current-direction planned command). Also check whether the vsdd-side crosslink-guide skill re-documents crosslink (should defer to crosslink's own help).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLARIFICATION (operator 2026-07-31) — SUPERSEDES my prior 'remove mdatron.docs.search'. The principle is AUTHOR vs CONSUME: each tool AUTHORS/owns its own docs (mdatron, crosslink, Claude Code, Anthropic); vsdd does NOT re-author/duplicate them, but vsdd SHOULD CONSUME them where they exist. So the mcp-serve *.docs.search tools are the CORRECT consumption mechanism (WebFetch+extract the authoritative source) — KEEP all: methodology.lookup (vsdd's own) + mdatron.docs.search + crosslink.docs.search + claude_code.docs.search + anthropic.api.docs.search. mdatron.docs.search STAYS (consumes mdatron's own docs). REQ-20 stands as written (consume via MCP, not grep). The real violation to find is anywhere vsdd RE-AUTHORS others' docs. Gaps: crosslink has no queryable docs surface today (only --help + knowledge pages) → the consumer needs crosslink to expose one (upstream request) or consume --help/knowledge; Claude Code (code.claude.com/docs) + Anthropic (platform.claude.com/docs) exist → consume. No subsume-agent correction sent (REQ-20 is correct as-is).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DECISION (operator 2026-07-31): SCRAP vsdd mcp-serve. Rationale: under-baked (spec only in the sunsetting DESIGN docs, never re-homed); 3/4 tools are brittle external-doc scrapers (WebFetch+extract, 5-20k tokens/query); and it DUPLICATES existing affordances — crosslink knowledge (search_knowledge MCP + knowledge pages), the agent's built-in WebFetch/WebSearch, and each sibling tool's own docs surface. Building it is the hand-roll-an-existing-affordance anti-pattern REQ-5/REQ-20/§355 forbid — it would fail the subsystem's own law. The knowledge-surfacing NEED is covered by those existing affordances (nothing lost). Actions: remove vsdd mcp-serve from the planned command surface; REQ-20 re-points knowledge-surfacing from 'build a docs-server' to 'ride existing affordances (crosslink knowledge + WebFetch/WebSearch + consume sibling docs surfaces)'; the DESIGN-doc mcp-serve spec dies with the sunset (NO re-home). Forward command surface: gate conformance, dispatch, insight, gate budget. crosslink-guide skill = crosslink's own self-doc (not vsdd-prefixed, outside mdatron govern) — fine, not a re-authoring violation.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: REVERSAL (operator 2026-07-31): the mcp-serve SCRAP is retracted. The search capability (methodology.lookup — targeted 1-5k-token search over vsdd's own methodology corpus, cooperating with crosslink knowledge, mtime-aware cache, instead of bulk-loading a 34k mega-design or grepping) is the POINT — it is the read-inflation fix, core to the efficiency thesis. My scrap over-weighted the external *.docs.search overlap with WebFetch. Correct direction: KEEP the search core; MATURE the under-baked design in a proper pass (rough edges: brittle external scraping, the retired observe-namespaced mcp-cache commands, absorbability hand-waving); apply the own/consume boundary to the external tools (mdatron/crosslink own+expose their docs, vsdd consumes; claude/anthropic via WebFetch/their surfaces). mcp-serve stays on the current-direction command surface (needs re-home from the sunsetting docs + a design pass), NOT scrapped. Confirming the 'search doing thing' framing with the operator before the re-design; halted the design-doc scrap edit (revert sent).
